purpose: home design concept images, not implementation assets or functional UI

prompts.a:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one finished premium Korean mobile homepage design image for sajulife, a saju plus temperament self-understanding app with an intimate, candid older-sister voice. Portrait 9:16 composition, full-bleed actual UI screenshot; no device frame, no moodboard, no scene around the screen.
Art direction A, '다정한 직구': sophisticated contemporary Korean character illustration and collectible editorial branding. Warm peach paper, deep burgundy, dusty coral. Sharp legible Korean serif headline and restrained sans serif UI. The design must have an unmistakable original illustrated hero, not a text-only layout. Central 45% of screen: a stylish adult Korean older-sister character with expressive black bob, thin burgundy glasses, burgundy scarf and cream shirt, raising one eyebrow with a caring half-smile, leaning toward the viewer, holding an open folded paper portrait. The folded portrait juxtaposes four finely illustrated traditional saju birth pillars with expressive wavy temperament brush lines. Rich hand-painted gouache and fine screenprint grain, exquisite tangible paper cut layers, witty character acting. Modern and warm, never generic fortune-teller clip art or a childish cartoon. Hero breaks a softly curved arch composition; asymmetrical framing, carefully designed small visual accents. Top wordmark 'sajulife', beneath it exact Korean headline '빙빙 안 돌려.\n네 얘기, 해보자.' One small illustrated conversation ribbon reads '괜찮다면서, 왜 계속 신경 써?' Wide burgundy primary CTA near bottom exact text '내 사주와 기질 보기' with subtle arrow. Underneath a small elegantly illustrated three-step pictorial strip. Include small label '말투 예시' near the conversation ribbon. Strong intentional visual design and generous useful space. No prices, no fake charts or fake ratings, no additional long copy. Production-quality polished consumer app, Korean characters verbatim and clean.
prompts.b: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium production-quality mobile homepage image for 'sajulife', Korean saju + temperament interpretation, candid caring older sister calls out patterns. Vertical 9:16 full-bleed app screenshot, no phone frame, no presentation board. Art direction B '할 말은 하는 내 편': warm ivory, saturated cobalt blue, charcoal typography, confident contemporary Korean editorial design, generous spacing, polished bespoke resources. Central hero illustration occupies at least 45%: an original memorable Korean woman advisor rendered as sophisticated dimensional paper sculpture, subtle clay depth. Short black bob, cobalt jacket, one raised eyebrow, knowing half-smile, relaxed leaning toward viewer. Friendly honesty, not aggression. She holds a sculptural mirror: left half reveals a beautifully composed saju calendar grid and four symbolic birth pillars, right half reveals a fluid expressive human silhouette and intertwined personality ribbons. Visually connect inherited patterns and present reactions. Crisp bespoke shapes, tactile shadows, exquisite material details. No zodiac clipart, floating dashboard cards or giant quote marks. Compact brand header, strong two-line Korean headline above character, richly illustrated hero middle, one large dark rounded CTA below, small three-step pictorial strip at bottom calendar→response marks→integrated portrait. Only these exact texts: Brand 'sajulife'. Headline '내가 왜 이러는지,\n이제 좀 알자.' CTA '내 얘기 들어보기'. Meticulous Korean typography, believable mobile proportions, finished commercial interface.
prompts.c: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium mobile homepage UI image for SAJULIFE, a Korean saju plus temperament service with candid familiar tough-love voice. 9:16 portrait full-bleed app screenshot. No phone frame or presentation board. Art direction C '솔직한 한 방': bold editorial street-culture luxury, warm chalk-white canvas, near-black typography, electric coral-red accent. Strong negative space, oversized Korean sans serif, precise alignment, distinctive consumer brand. ORIGINAL hero asset at least45% of screen: sculptural black rubber tiger character with coral lacquer facial details, one raised eyebrow, knowing slightly unimpressed expression, candid but affectionate. Tiger gently pulls aside a translucent coral acetate mask, revealing intricate fingerprint-like temperament contours underneath. Beside paw stand four small red stone tablets engraved with abstract celestial marks suggesting saju four birth pillars. Premium tactile materials, exquisite 3D lighting, expressive silhouette, subtle contact shadows. Integrate sculpture naturally with interface, no card or placeholder. Top small 'SAJULIFE' wordmark. Main headline exact Korean '좋은 말만\n듣고 싶어?' Small support line '사주 + 기질로, 내 패턴 보기'. Bottom wide coral CTA exact '내 사주와 기질 보기' with small northeast arrow. Minimal three-step footer numbered graphic marks. No other Korean copy. Sophisticated memorable legible finished production interface.
prompts.d: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality Korean mobile app homepage screenshot, 9:16 portrait, full bleed, NO phone frame. Art direction D '근거 있는 한마디': an insightful friend tells useful truth, expressed through meticulous editorial craft and sculptural paper illustration. Warm ivory, deep forest green, charcoal typography, precise hairline rules, generous spacing. Confident intimate sophisticated. ORIGINAL commissioned-quality hero illustration MUST occupy at least45% of screen: a large sculptural layered-paper self portrait, two exquisitely interlocking abstract human face profiles in forest-green and ivory paper, introspective yet witty silhouette with a lifted eyebrow expressed by one precise carved curve. A translucent green acetate sheet peels away from a complex paper knot to uncover two distinct constructions within the portrait: an ordered four-column birth-chart lattice and flowing folded ribbons representing everyday temperament. Intricate paper cut edges, deeply embossed details, folded tabs, translucent vellum, directional studio lighting, realistic soft shadows. Modern Korean cultural editorial craft. More sophisticated abstract paper art than a cartoon mascot; no generic icon, no chart card. The portrait should feel like uncovering repeated patterns together. Small wordmark 'sajulife' at top. Main headline, perfectly legible elegant Korean serif: '좋은 말보다,\n맞는 말을.' Sculpture dominates central composition, intersects editorial margins. Bottom one large forest-green CTA exact '사주와 기질로 나 읽기'. Only these three text elements. No giant quotation marks, fake stats, reviews, English filler, multiple cards, or fortune-telling clichés. Finished beautiful usable commercial app interface.
